request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour only the frosting: the pink frosting dripping over the donut becomes dark chocolate glaze #4a2412 with a lighter #7a4526 shine and a few tiny cream and gold sprinkles; any other pink part becomes cream. No pink is left. Keep the golden dough, the hole, the candy-corn rider, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
